energy-track-bars.alt: A block released from rest at A, 6.0 m above the lowest point B of a frictionless curved track, slides through B and up to C, 2.0 m above B. Bar charts at A, B and C show kinetic energy, gravitational potential energy and their constant total: 0 and 6 units at A, 6 and 0 at B, 4 and 2 at C.
